svg.title: Document routing
svg.desc: Animation: a grid of 100 documents fills in three steps. 63 go straight through to the ERP, shown green. 37 have at least one flagged field and go to human review, shown amber. Two of the auto-approved documents, about 3 percent, are picked for audit, shown indigo. Reviewers see only flagged fields with the source region highlighted. Illustrative.
svg.text: Validation first, then confidence. A random sample of auto-approved documents is audited. Illustrative.
Reviewers see only the flagged fields, pre-filled, with the source region highlighted.
Corrections become eval cases; audits estimate the error rate you can't otherwise see.
